shared_qualifications: C1: conditional 25°C saturated-KCl SCE comparison E(mV,SCE)=E(mV,NHE)−241. Corrtest specifies SCE +0.241 V versus NHE at 25°C: https://www.corrtestinstruments.com/en/02437.html . NHE is treated as the hydrogen reference named by the paper. CRA does not specify the physical reference electrode temperature/filling; numerical agreement is conditional on this standard SCE convention, not an offset fitted to targets.

PDF p.2 Figure 1 scan 50 mV/30 s =1.6666667 mV/s, compatible with CRA 1.66. The separate 2 V/h passivation measurements on pp.1–2 are a different protocol. All Figure 2 results at 25°C (p.3); quenched 1120°C/water samples.

Figure 2 E′np and limiting induction-time E_np are distinct. No-pitting limits, imposed-potential bounds and Table 2 inequalities are not substituted for scan thresholds. Numerical pH 1 in CRA is not an independently stated paper value.

Obs_005: primary Figure 2 ≈690 mV NHE differs from explicitly annotated Figure 1 ≈650. C1 gives ≈449 versus ≈409 mV SCE; CRA No.276=453.808704961359. Identity is supported, but the secondary source reading is discrepant. Obs_007/009/010 retain less pronounced Figure 2/Figure 4 graphical differences.
Filename cites p.349; visually verified supplied title/authors and actual printed pp.394–397. All registry anchors refer to this supplied PDF.
